faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ARPS Principal recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ARPS Principal recruitment is 05 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Principal post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Principal post, candidates must possess a Master's Degree with a minimum of 50% marks, a B.Ed degree, and be CTET Qualified. Adequate computer knowledge is also a prerequisite.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Principal position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Principal position at Assam Rifles Public School will primarily involve an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the ARPS Principal recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and submit it via post or as instructed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Principal post must have a minimum of 05 to 08 years of teaching and administrative experience. This experience is crucial for evaluating the suitability of the candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Principal post at Assam Rifles Public School is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a specified period as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Assam Rifles Public School located?
faq.answer: Assam Rifles Public School (ARPS) is located in Shillong, Meghalaya, with the pincode 793010. Candidates should ensure they are willing to work at this location.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxations for the Principal post. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such details.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the application form. Ensure all necessary documents are included.
